The short answer

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges pre-booked private transfers for NEOM through a vetted partner network. Most visitors land at Tabuk Regional Airport (TUU), about 180 km (~2 hr 45 min) from NEOM, or at Red Sea International (about 300 km). Confirmed points are NEOM Bay / Sharma, Magna and Oxagon; for other NEOM sites, send the location and we confirm first — site access is arranged by your host. Aqaba in Jordan is about 235 km via the Al Durrah crossing.

Before you book

Getting to NEOM: what to know first

NEOM is a very large region still under development, so the details matter more than in a city.

Name the exact place

"NEOM" is not one address. Sharma (NEOM Bay), Magna and Oxagon are our confirmed points; for anywhere else, send the location first and we confirm whether a transfer is possible.

Your host arranges access

Many NEOM sites have controlled entry. Ask your host for the gate or meeting point and pass it on — we plan around it but cannot arrange access ourselves.

Jordan is close on the coast

From the NEOM coast the shortest way into Jordan is the Al Durrah crossing near Haql — Haql to Aqaba is about 40 km.

Honest comparison

NEOM: fly into Tabuk or Red Sea Airport?

Both work. It depends on where in NEOM you are going and which flight suits you.

Red Sea International (RSI)

  • • About 300 km to NEOM
  • • Useful if your flight times suit RSI
  • • Also serves the Red Sea resorts

Tabuk Airport (TUU)

  • • About 180 km — the shorter drive
  • • The usual choice for site visitors
  • • Tabuk city nearby for hotels

Chauffeur by the hour

A car and driver for NEOM days

Distances in the region are long, so a car that stays with you for the day — site, meeting, hotel, airport — often works better than separate transfers. The fare for the whole day is agreed before booking.

Plan your timing

What changes timing for NEOM trips

01

Long empty roads

Legs of 100 km or more are normal here. Plan arrivals from the flight time and allow for a rest stop.

02

Border crossings

Jordan crossings add queue time that varies by day. Do not book a tight connection on the Jordan side.

03

Site entry

Gate checks take time even with clearance. Leave a margin before the first meeting.

FAQ

NEOM transport questions

Ask on WhatsApp

How do I get from Tabuk Airport to NEOM?

By pre-booked private car: about 180 km (~2 hr 45 min). We track your flight, meet you at arrivals and drive you to the NEOM destination you give us.

Which places in NEOM can you drive to?

Our confirmed points are NEOM Bay / Sharma, Magna and Oxagon. For any other NEOM site, send the location and we confirm whether a transfer is possible before quoting; site access is arranged by your host.

Can I go from NEOM to Aqaba in Jordan?

Yes, about 235 km via the Al Durrah crossing. The vehicle's border fees are included; passengers bring their own passports and visas. A cheaper option drops you at the Saudi side of the border.

Is NEOM car rental the same as this?

We do not rent self-drive cars — every booking is a car with a professional driver. The fare for the car and driver is agreed before you travel.

Can my company get a written quote?

Yes — email the dates, people and sites. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.

Is transport available 24/7?

Yes. Pre-book night and early-morning airport legs so the car is planned in advance.
